_comment: Member360 PA Datamart - single source of truth for pipeline configuration. All generator scripts read this; nothing is hardcoded in the generators.

scale._comment: Small profile: uses the Synthea 1K-patient sample directly with no upsampling. Member count is discovered from the fetched Synthea patients.csv at runtime; this is the cap.

determinism._comment: Every stochastic decision derives from this seed. Changing it changes the data; keeping it guarantees byte-identical reruns, which the determinism test asserts.

date_anchor._comment: Synthea sample data ends in 2020. PA work needs live SLA clocks, so the whole timeline is shifted forward deterministically: the latest source encounter is mapped to (today - recent_activity_buffer_days) and every other date shifts by the same integer offset, preserving all intervals exactly.
date_anchor._reference_date_note: null = resolve to today at runtime. Set an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to pin the pipeline for reproducible demos.

open_datasets._comment: All URLs HTTP-200 verified 2026-09-01. Each entry has a fallback strategy because CMS reorganizes file paths and community mirrors can disappear.

synthea.role: PRIMARY - referentially intact synthetic patient population across 16 CSVs

fda_ndc.role: Real NDC drug codes, therapeutic classes, DEA schedule

icd10cm.role: Real ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes + descriptions for the crosswalk

hcpcs.role: Real HCPCS Level II procedure codes + descriptions

synpuf_beneficiary.role: CALIBRATION ONLY - real Medicare cost-sharing distributions used to shape synthetic accumulators. Not a row source.

nppes._api_note: state alone is rejected by the API; city+state or last_name is required.
nppes.role: Real NPIs where obtainable; deterministic synthetic NPIs (Luhn-valid) as fallback

snowflake._comment: connection_name is used ONLY to look up the non-secret account/user/role from ~/.snowflake/connections.toml. Authentication itself is non-interactive and comes from an environment variable.
snowflake._auth_note: Interactive browser OAuth is NOT supported. Its token expires mid-run and cannot work unattended. Set SNOWFLAKE_PAT (preferred), SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH, or SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD. Store the value with 'cortex secret store snowflake_pat --prompt' and inject it with 'cortex secret run --map snowflake_pat=SNOWFLAKE_PAT -- <command>' so it never lands on disk or in shell history.
snowflake.load_batch_note: One connection is opened per run and reused for every table.

rbac._comment: app_role is the Streamlit identity: USAGE on database + SERVING only, SELECT on views only. It must NOT be able to read BRONZE/SILVER/GOLD; the verifier asserts this negatively.

governance._comment: The assistant is exploratory and NON-decision-making. These column names are banned everywhere in the mart; the validator fails the build if any appears.
